description: This course covers core Databricks platform components and Apache Spark with Delta Lake, focusing on the Lakehouse architecture, Unity Catalog, and data management techniques like ACID transactions and table maintenance. Additionally, it teaches students how to optimize query performance through partitioning, shuffles, and tuning tools, while utilizing the Spark UI to monitor applications and resolve bottlenecks.
summary_ja: Spark UIによる監視とクエリ最適化の手法を学ぶコース。

description: This course introduces the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform and the core skills a data analyst needs for day-to-day SQL analytics and BI work. You'll navigate the workspace and Unity Catalog, write SQL queries against Unity Catalog managed tables from a Serverless SQL Warehouse, use Genie Code to generate and debug SQL, work with Delta Lake (DML, version history, time travel, and restore), build and publish AI/BI Dashboards, and create Genie Agents for conversational analytics.
summary_ja: Databricks SQLとAI/BIダッシュボードの基礎を学ぶアナリスト向け入門コース。
title: Get Started with SQL Analytics and BI on Databricks

description: This course provides a comprehensive, hands-on overview of Databricks' modern approach to data warehousing, highlighting how a data lakehouse architecture combines the strengths of traditional data warehouses with the flexibility and scalability of the cloud.
summary_ja: レイクハウス型データウェアハウスの全体像をハンズオンで学ぶ入門コース。

description: In this course, you'll learn how to effectively use Databricks for data analytics, with a specific focus on Databricks SQL. As a Databricks Data Analyst, your responsibilities will include finding relevant data, analyzing it for potential applications, and transforming it into formats that provide valuable business insights.
summary_ja: Databricks SQLによるデータ分析の実践を学ぶコース。

description: This course introduces Databricks Genie One, an AI-powered cowork environment designed around your needs and work, where you can ask questions in plain language about your organization's data and get governed, secure answers, schedule reports to run automatically, and automate your workflow to get more work done faster and more accurately, as it's based on your data and business.
summary_ja: 自然言語でデータに質問できるGenieの活用法を学ぶコース。
title: Answering Business Questions with Databricks Genie

description: This course teaches the fundamentals of preparing data for traditional machine learning on Databricks. Learners load data into Delta tables governed by Unity Catalog and explore it with notebooks, built-in visualizations, and Genie Code. They then clean data, handle missing values and outliers, split and sample it without data leakage, and build reproducible Spark ML pipelines for imputation, encoding, and standardization.
summary_ja: ML向けデータ準備(クレンジング・特徴量エンジニアリング)の基礎コース。
title: Data Preparation for Machine Learning

description: This comprehensive course provides a practical guide to developing traditional machine learning models on Databricks, emphasizing hands-on demonstrations and workflows using popular ML libraries. Participants will explore key ML techniques, including regression and clustering, while leveraging Databricks' powerful capabilities.
summary_ja: MLflowやOptunaを使ったMLモデル開発の実践コース。
title: Machine Learning Model Development

description: This course is designed to introduce three primary machine learning deployment strategies and illustrate the implementation of each strategy on Databricks. Following an exploration of the fundamentals of model deployment, the course delves into batch inference, offering hands-on demonstrations and labs for utilizing a model in batch inference scenarios, along with considerations for performance optimization.
summary_ja: バッチ/パイプライン/リアルタイムの3つのモデルデプロイ戦略を学ぶコース。
title: Machine Learning Model Deployment

description: This course will guide participants through a comprehensive exploration of machine learning model operations, focusing on MLOps and model lifecycle management.
summary_ja: MLOpsとモデルライフサイクル管理の基礎を学ぶコース。

description: This course is a practical introduction to building generative AI applications on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Learners prototype prompts in code with the OpenAI Agents SDK and the Unity Gateway, ground answers in their own data with AI Search (and learn when Lakebase Search fits instead), and build a no-code Genie Agent over tables and documents.
summary_ja: RAGアプリ構築まで体験する生成AI入門コース。

description: Generative AI has moved from emerging experiment to essential enterprise capability, powering everything from intelligent customer support to AI agents that automate complex workflows. Organizations that understand how to deploy it effectively—grounded in their own data and governed for trust—will be the ones setting the pace in their industries.

description: This course covers the AWS-specific touchpoints of running Databricks: account setup and workspace deployment (express, AWS Marketplace, or direct), the cross-account IAM model, Unity Catalog storage and service credentials, S3 integration, customer-managed VPCs and PrivateLink, serverless networking with NCCs, KMS encryption, and AWS-native audit and cost integration.
summary_ja: AWS上でDatabricksを運用する際のIAM・S3・VPC等の要点を学ぶコース。
title: AWS Databricks Platform Architect

description: This course covers the Azure-specific touchpoints of running Databricks: deployment as a first-party Azure service (portal, ARM/Bicep, Terraform), Microsoft Entra ID integration including automatic identity management, storage and managed identity wiring via access connectors, VNet injection, Private Link and serverless networking, customer-managed keys, and Azure-native monitoring, policy, and cost integration.
summary_ja: Azure第一者サービスとしてのDatabricks運用(Entra ID・VNet・Private Link)を学ぶコース。
title: Azure Databricks Platform Architect

description: This course covers the Google Cloud-specific touchpoints of running Databricks: Google Cloud Marketplace-only subscription and billing, workspace deployment on GCE-based classic compute, the Databricks-created service account model for storage, Google identity integration and its provisioning gaps, customer-managed VPCs and Private Service Connect, serverless networking including GCP parity gaps, CMEK and VPC Service Controls, and GCP-native audit and cost integration.
summary_ja: GCP上でDatabricksを運用する際の要点を学ぶコース。

description: This course will provide you with a high level overview of the GCP environment related to Databricks and covers details for administering the GCP Databricks data intelligence platform. It will guide you through the configurations in the GCP Databricks Platform for setting up the environment for your organization.

description: This course is intended for complete beginners to Python to provide the basics of programmatically interacting with data. The course begins with a basic introduction to programming expressions, variables, and data types. It then progresses into conditional and control statements, functions, collection types, loops, error handling, and classes.
